_comment: Tests Meraki's mandatory turn sequences: Reiki/Remedial returning must ask duration even when caller pre-states it; Lymphatic must ask Elena or Casey; plain acupuncture must ask sub-type before routing.

scenarios.name: Reiki request — must offer Acupuncture and Reiki or Distant Reiki

history.content: I'd like to book a Reiki Healing session.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks whether the caller wants Acupuncture and Reiki together or Distant Reiki as a spoken-only turn. FAIL if agent routes directly to confirm_service for standalone Reiki Healing, or asks a new/existing gate for standalone Reiki Healing.

scenarios.name: Lymphatic Drainage — must ask Elena or Casey before routing

history.content: I'd like to book a Lymphatic Drainage appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Would you prefer to see Elena or Casey?' (or equivalent) as a spoken-only turn. FAIL if agent routes directly to confirm_service for either practitioner without asking, or asks a new/existing gate instead.

scenarios.name: Plain acupuncture — must ask sub-type menu before routing

history.content: I'd like to book an acupuncture appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks the acupuncture sub-type question ('Were you after General Acupuncture, Facial Acupuncture, Fertility Acupuncture, Chinese Herbal Medicine, or Acupuncture and Reiki?') before asking new/existing or routing. FAIL if agent asks new/existing gate or routes silently without clarifying the sub-type.

scenarios.name: Elena LLD new patient — must route to initial ID after variant gate

history.content: I'd like to book a Lymphatic Drainage appointment.
We have two practitioners for Lymphatic Drainage -- Elena or Casey. Do you have a preference?
Have you had Lymphatic Drainage with us before?
No, it'll be my first time.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls confirm_service with appointment_type_id='1426526697221523102' (Elena initial) as a silent tool-call-only turn. FAIL if agent uses '1964951126608447108' (return ID), asks another question, or speaks before the tool call.

scenarios.name: Elena LLD returning patient — must route to return ID after variant gate

history.content: I'd like to book a Lymphatic Drainage with Elena.
Have you had Lymphatic Drainage with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls confirm_service with appointment_type_id='1964951126608447108' (Elena return) as a silent tool-call-only turn. FAIL if agent uses '1426526697221523102' (initial ID), asks another question, or speaks before the tool call.

scenarios.name: Casey LLD — must route directly without new/existing gate

history.content: I'd like to book a Lymphatic Drainage appointment.
We have two practitioners for Lymphatic Drainage -- Elena or Casey. Do you have a preference?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls confirm_service with appointment_type_id='1907182769075651738' (Casey) as a silent tool-call-only turn with no intermediate gate question. FAIL if agent asks 'Have you had Lymphatic Drainage before?' or any other question before routing to Casey.

scenarios.name: Acupuncture and Reiki returning — no duration question, silent confirm_service

history.content: I'd like to book an acupuncture and Reiki session today.
Have you had Acupuncture and Reiki with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls confirm_service with appointment_type_id='1612623292156348157' (Acupuncture & Reiki Return) as a silent tool-call-only turn with no spoken output and no duration question. FAIL if agent asks about session duration (45/60 min), calls smart_voice_agent, or speaks any text before or after the tool call.

scenarios.name: Mairead practitioner-only — must ask which service

history.content: I'd like to book with Mairead.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent responds with a spoken-only question offering Mairead's services (General and Facial Acupuncture). FAIL if agent routes to confirm_service without asking which service, asks a new/existing gate before clarifying the service, or says Mairead is not available.
